north_star: Measure whether A-Momentum discovery materially provides differentiated buyer/commercial insight usable by Daily7, not success by quantity of receipts or probes.

one_selected_lead.research_scope: Cause affiliation, survivor/supporter identity, personal water bottle/laptop decals, awareness walk/team gifting.
one_selected_lead.why_selected: October-specific potential buyer occasion plus traceable physical-sticker buyer reviews; not because market/newness/profitability is proven.

direct_buyer_review_examples.insight_paraphrase: Buyer preferred a tasteful, non-cheesy expression.
Buyer planned to display the sticker on a water bottle.
Buyer used stickers for a cancer walk team.

one_selected_lead.review_interpretation_limits: 22 reviews belong to this item; seller-wide review and sales totals are not item sell-through or Amazon demand proof.

direct_market_context.observation: Broad 4000+ search result includes digital downloads and physical forms; not a direct-physical-competitor count.
Physical ribbon decals, personalized stickers, support phrases, and packs appear alongside digital and unrelated formats; competition breadth evident, no rigorous density count.
A physical multi-pack competes in ribbon awareness/bulk use.
Watercolor floral awareness label and stationery expression already sold.
Accessories-wide sales estimates mix pens, clothing and bracelets; not specific to vinyl stickers; excluded from Amazon sticker demand proof.

clear_buyer_segment_and_jtbd.evidence: Direct buyer reviews show tasteful self-expression, water-bottle display, and cancer-walk/team usage. Segment sizes unmeasured.

observed_commerce_demand_signal.evidence: An Etsy physical sticker has 22 item reviews; other physical listings exist. Current US Amazon sales/BSR remain unverified.

amazon_query_language_path.evidence: Candidate keywords are credible research hypotheses, but no directly verified corresponding Amazon sticker ASIN and actual query/BSR binding.

mechanism_portability_and_independence.evidence: Cause affiliation survives sticker format, but no specific unique wording or hybrid mechanism has passed distinctiveness/portability examination.

conversion_bearing_aesthetic_dna.evidence: One buyer sought a tasteful non-cheesy design; no evidence a proposed new visual/wording execution converts distinctly from existing variants.

competition_headroom.evidence: Multiple existing ribbons, personalized survivor decals, bundles, and floral labels make obvious variants crowded. No quantified Amazon sticker review moat, competing-ASIN landscape, or unmet job proven.

us_native_tone.evidence: US buyer use context is real, but there is no frozen W/H candidate phrase or hybrid execution to evaluate for natural American expression.

current_source_and_freshness.evidence: Etsy listing and 2026 buyer reviews observed; old M-rising snapshots and A1 failed native series cannot establish current trend velocity.

commercial_gate.reason: No sufficiently differentiated physical-sticker expression, no demonstrated competition headroom, and Amazon sticker query/ASIN/BSR path unverified despite credible buyer precedent.

reflection.genuine_progress: Resolved one market-quality screening decision from frozen discovery evidence and concrete buyer reviews; prevented premature Daily7 promotion.
reflection.commercial_learning: Buyer preference for tasteful/less-cheesy solidarity display and walk-team use is supported by item reviews; common generic ribbon executions are not shown to have fresh headroom.
reflection.not_proven: No one new Amazon sticker opportunity successfully commercial-qualified; cannot claim improved Daily7 winner yield.
reflection.anti_loop: Stop this lead at commercial gate. Do not widen to a second lead or add A3, sensors, lifecycle, or handoff automation merely to force PASS.
reflection.next_monotonic_frontier: Only revisit when a NEW independently sourced differentiated W/H expression and Amazon sticker competitor/demand evidence make the failed commercial dimensions testable; otherwise leave parked.
